      usage

        qwen3:8b · offline demo · ctx 12%^k commands · alt n new · alt i info · alt t tint

        What it does

        05 entries

        01

        Any model

        Ollama, llama.cpp, or any OpenAI compatible endpoint. Switch with one flag or from the palette.

        --model
        02

        Plain when piped

        No escape codes when stdout is not a terminal. Pipe the answer into a file or another tool.

        | tee
        03

        Keyboard first

        Every action has a key. The palette finds the rest. The mouse is optional.

        ctrl k
        04

        Sessions are files

        Plain text in your config folder. Grep them, diff them, delete them. No account.

        ~/.angelify
        05

        Diffs you can read

        Changes show as + and - with the file path. No color is needed to read them.

        + / -

        Keys

        work in the demo above

        KeyActionWhere
        ctrl kOpen the command paletteanywhere
        enterSend the messagecomposer
        shift enterNew linecomposer
        alt nNew sessionanywhere
        alt iShow or hide session infoanywhere
        alt tCold or neutral tintanywhere
        j / kMove between sessionssession list
        escClose the palettepalette

        Config

        ~/.angelify/config.toml · sample

        One file. Every value has a default, so an empty file works. The tint and the idle art are part of the config, not a theme store.

        Art only shows in an empty session. It leaves as soon as you type.

        [model]
provider = "ollama"
name     = "qwen3:8b"
context  = 32768

[ui]
tint     = "neutral"
art      = "idle"
grain    = true

[tools]
read     = true
edit     = true
shell    = "ask"
